Subject: postfix making too many queries to LDAP

I know I queried this a year ago and received some responses that explained
what was happening (i.e. that extra queries were required to ensure that the
mail address was not another alias and that different components of postfix
require access to the same or related data) however these responses did not
clarify some important points for me:

1. why do subsequent queries use different portions of the address (lhs and
some combinations of the rhs), which cannot be valid addresses?
2. how do I turn off this 'feature'?
3. why should I not turn it off?

If I can't achieve 2 then at least an answer to 1 and/or 3 may help me to
justify this excess query traffic to our LDAP admins whose complaints are
getting louder by the day.

They are claiming that 80+% of queries to the LDAP are for entries that
could not exist. e.g:

(&(mail=.co.za)(mailAccountStatus=active))
(&(mail=.za)(mailAccountStatus=active))
(&(mail=.co.za)(mailAccountStatus=active))
(&(mail=.za)(mailAccountStatus=active))
(&(mail=.za)(mailAccountStatus=active))
(&(mail=.co.za)(mailAccountStatus=active))
(&(mail=mweb.co.za)(mailAccountStatus=active))
(&(mail=webmail.co.za)(mailAccountStatus=active))
(&(mail=.za)(mailAccountStatus=active))
(&(mail=.co.za)(mailAccountStatus=active))
(&(mail=.za)(mailAccountStatus=active))
(&(mail=dc-tech.co.za)(mailAccountStatus=active))

none of the above can be valid email addresses. The only two query_filters
configured for postfix are:

(&(mailAlternateAddress=%s)(mailAccountStatus=active)) in ldap-alias.cf and
(&(mail=%s)(mailAccountStatus=active)) in  ldap-mailbox.cf,
ldap-sasl-password.cf, ldap-login_maps.cf,  ldap-mailhost.cf and
ldap-valid-senders.cf

help,

mike
